arc.fallback: The Three from a Faraway Land

description.fallback: When Dio sees Jonathan, he realizes that Tarkus and Bruford have failed their tasks. Given this new opportunity, several of the surrounding zombies jump at the chance to kill Jonathan and please their master. However, Dio stops them and says he would like to be the one to beat Jonathan himself.
